isotherm.awRefSource: chamber plateau relative humidity from attachment 1 (derived, not assumed)

isotherm.status: family of closures; the material's true isotherm is not provided

anchor.note: a_w(C_eq) is forced to the chamber relative humidity because the stated equilibrium point can neither gain nor lose water

baselineLimit.independentCheck: core.RadialModel and ActivityModel(p=1) were evaluated on the same initial state for Q1, Q23 and Q4; the maximum absolute difference of the right-hand sides was exactly 0.0 in all three cases
